title: Kazunari Hanao joins Vercel as Country Manager, Japan
summary_en: 日本語版はこちら： Vercel日本法人の代表に花尾和成が就任いたしました Kazunari Hanao has joined Vercel as Country Manager for Japan, based in Tokyo. His appointment is part of our continued investment in the Japanese market, including plans to expand our local team. Japanese developers were early adopters of Next.js. And today, Vercel's customers in Japan include Mitsubishi Corporation, Fujitsu Limited, U-NEXT CO., Ltd., and DeNA Co., Ltd., alongside startups like SANU Inc. and Reiwa Travel, Inc.
